query: What items are required to start Monkey Madness I?

answer.query: What items are required to start Monkey Madness I?
answer.answer: To start Monkey Madness I, you need the following items: a gold bar, five empty inventory slots, a ball of wool, monkey bones or a corpse from Karamja (obtainable during the quest), and five bananas (also obtainable during the quest).

query: What is the Abyssal whip's special attack?

answer.query: What is the Abyssal whip's special attack?
answer.answer: The Abyssal whip's special attack is called "Energy Drain." It uses 50% special attack energy and, in PvP, transfers 10% of the target's run energy to the user. Its effect is described as an attack with 25% increased accuracy that siphons 10% of the target's run energy. It uses a Slash defence roll, has a 25% attack roll modifier, no damage roll modifier, and requires level 70 to use.

query: How do you defeat Zooknock in Monkey Madness I?

answer.query: How do you defeat Zooknock in Monkey Madness I?
answer.answer: You don't actually "defeat" Zooknock in combat during Monkey Madness I — he is a gnome mage NPC you interact with peacefully, not an enemy to fight. Zooknock is found at the end of the dangerous Ape Atoll dungeon tunnel (a journey full of hazards like floor spikes, rock traps, and falling rocks that you must navigate, taking at least three minutes of running while using Protect from Melee and eating food/drinking potions as needed). Once you reach him along with the gnomes Waymottin and Bunkwicket, you simply talk to him, then use the m'amulet mould, gold bar, and monkey dentures on him and speak to him again to receive an enchanted bar. Later in the quest, you also give him Monkey talismans and monkey bones (using the "use" option, not burying them) to receive Greegrees, one for each type of bones you provide (Karamjan, Ninja, Zombie, and Gorilla).

Even with consistent running, it will take at least three minutes of running to navigate the dungeon. Be prepared to drink your prayer and energy restoring potions, as well as food, when necessary.

At the end of the tunnel, you will find the gnomes Zooknock , Waymottin and Bunkwicket . Talk to Zooknock, and then use your m'amulet mould , gold bar , and monkey dentures on him and speak to him again. Make sure he gives you an enchanted bar before leaving the tunnel . Additionally, do not to use the m'amulet mould on Zooknock when you already have the enchanted bar , as he will keep the mould and you will have to obtain another. Teleport out, and bank if necessary. If you have not gone through all the dialogue with Garkor you will not be able to use the items on him.

Bring good Food , as well as Prayer , Antipoison , and Stamina / Energy potions. Follow the yellow path west and climb down the ladder. Run to the end of the dungeon. Use Protect from Melee prayer and ignore all the hazards, eating food and drinking potions as needed. Give Zooknock your Monkey talisman and Monkey bones (make sure these are bones from the regular monkeys; examine Text: These are small monkey bones. ). After a moment he will give you a Greegree . Do not accidentally bury the bones! Right click them and carefully select "use". Do not leave the dialogue with Zooknock prematurely. Should the player exit the cutscene before it has finished, talking to Zooknock again will restart the cutscene, and no items will be lost.
